title: High cpu usage and bad performance while many files are moved
line: Cutting and pasting thousands of files no longer makes Plasma use lots of CPU and memory or freeze the panel.
explanation: Two things made plasmashell work hard during a big move of cut files. KIO rewrote the clipboard with all the cut URLs after every single moved file, so Klipper received thousands of new 10,000-URL entries and hashed each one; and the clipboard popup's URL delegate could be briefly narrower than zero, making maximumNumberOfPreviews -1, which split() treats as no limit, so a preview was created for every URL. The plasma-workspace change (MR !7347) clamps the preview count to 0 or more; the KIO change records where the moved sources went and updates the clipboard once when the job ends.

commits.message:
klipper/declarative: avoid building previews for all copied URLs

The URL delegate can briefly be narrower than zero, which made its
maximumNumberOfPreviews -1, and split() takes a negative limit as no
limit, so the popup created a preview for every copied URL. Clamp it.

BUG: 469753

ClipboardUpdater: update the clipboard once per move

Moving files rewrote the clipboard with all the cut URLs after each one,
so thousands of files flooded clipboard managers like Klipper. Collect
where the sources went and update the clipboard once when the job ends.

BUG: 469753

From 65f84a87f70ff851b1e5f58e86ffc87a98607784 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:46:05 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] klipper/declarative: avoid building previews for all copied
 URLs

The URL delegate can briefly be narrower than zero, which made its
maximumNumberOfPreviews -1, and split() takes a negative limit as no
limit, so the popup created a preview for every copied URL. Clamp it.

BUG: 469753
---
 klipper/declarative/qml/UrlItemDelegate.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/klipper/declarative/qml/UrlItemDelegate.qml b/klipper/declarative/qml/UrlItemDelegate.qml
index 8c5d842b31..45fad0136e 100644
--- a/klipper/declarative/qml/UrlItemDelegate.qml
+++ b/klipper/declarative/qml/UrlItemDelegate.qml
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@ import org.kde.plasma.private.clipboard as Private // image provider
 
 ClipboardItemDelegate {
     id: menuItem
-    property int maximumNumberOfPreviews: Math.floor(width / (Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 4 + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing))
+    property int maximumNumberOfPreviews: Math.max(0, Math.floor(width / (Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 4 + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing)))
     Accessible.name: menuItem.model?.display ?? ""
     mainItem: Item {
         id: previewItem
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: 75 s after pasting 10,000 cut files plasmashell is at 102% CPU and 965 MB, the clipboard popup won't open and the clock is stuck.
With both fixes: plasmashell idle at 408 MB after the same move, and the clipboard popup opens at once with 5 previews and "+9,995".
Master: plasmashell CPU and memory every 3 s from the paste (130-226% CPU, RSS growing past 900 MB).
With both fixes: the same move peaks at 13% CPU and stays near 410 MB.

review.text: Both layers are the right places to fix this bug: the plasma-workspace QML clamp (MR !7347) cleanly prevents split(..., -1) from building 10,000 preview delegates, and batching clipboard updates per move job in KIO eliminates the thousands of per-file clipboard rewrites. However, the KIO ClipboardUpdater patch has regressions around cross-filesystem directory moves, setMode(), and shutdown safety that need to be fixed before merging.
changes: Handle directories moved across filesystems (or via merge fallback): CopyJob does not emit copyingDone/copyingLinkDone for directories copied recursively via mkdir + copy + rmdir, while the patch removes CopyJob handling from updateUrlsInClipboard() and suppresses SimpleJob RemoveContent for m_srcUrls, leaving moved directory URLs stale in the clipboard.

Make ClipboardUpdater::setMode() consistent with the batched CopyJob tracking: slotResult() currently short-circuits on !m_srcUrls.isEmpty() before switching on m_mode, and setMode() does not update m_srcUrls/s_moveUpdaters/signal connections, breaking OverwriteContent/RemoveContent or switching into UpdateContent after construction.
Guard QGuiApplication::clipboard() against nullptr in updateMovedUrls() (especially since it is now called from ~ClipboardUpdater(), which can run during application teardown or in headless tests).
Verify the cancel-mid-move and cross-filesystem directory move paths, and add unit test coverage for them in kiowidgets-clipboardupdatertest.
